title: 第23章 绝望的烟雨楼关键时机第24章 帝子降临
slug: 多子多福家族帮我攻略极品仙子
lines: 树林界，烟雨楼。
这座矗立在云雾缭绕的青山之上的宫殿，此刻却笼罩在一片死寂的氛围中。
大殿内，十几位烟雨楼的长老聚集在一起，每个人脸上都写满了焦虑和绝望。
“楼主，血煞宗的最后期限，只剩下两天了!”
一位白发苍苍的长老颤声说道，他的手紧紧握着拐杖，指节因为用力过度而泛白。
“我们真的要眼睁睁看着烟雨楼被灭门吗?”
另一位长老咬牙切齿地问道，眼中满是不甘。
主位上，秦月白静静地坐着。
她穿着一袭白色长裙，容貌绝美，气质出尘，如同谪仙下凡。
可那双美眸中，却透着深深的疲惫和无奈。
“诸位长老，我何尝不想保护烟雨楼?”
她轻声说道，声音中带着一丝苦涩。
“可血无涯是6境神通境，我即便拼尽全力，也根本不是他的对手。”
“楼主!”
一位中年长老突然站起来，眼中闪过一丝疯狂。
“我们都知道，您的并蒂莲华体，有一个特殊的能力…”
他的话没说完，但所有人都明白他的意思。
大殿内的气氛瞬间凝固了。
秦月白的身体微微一颤，她缓缓抬起头，目光扫过在场的每一个人。
“你们…想让我吞噬婠婠?”
她的声音很轻，却让所有人都听得清清楚楚。
“楼主恕罪!”
那位中年长老跪了下来，但语气依旧坚定。
“可这是唯一的办法了!您的并蒂莲华体，本就是一体双生，若能双体合一，必然能突破6境!到时候，血无涯算什么?我们烟雨楼不仅能保住，还能一举称霸树林界！”
“对!楼主，为了烟雨楼数千弟子的性命，您必须做出选择!”
“楼主，大义当前，不能妇人之仁啊!”
一个接一个的长老跪了下来，他们的声音越来越大，越来越急切。
秦月白闭上了眼睛。
她知道，这些长老说的都是对的。
并蒂莲华体的特殊之处就在于，它本就是一体双生，可以分裂出另一个个体，也可以重新合一。
而一旦合一，两股力量叠加，必然能让她突破现有的境界。
可是…
她睁开眼，目光落在大殿角落里，那个安静站着的少女身上。
秦婠婠。
她的“女儿”。
虽然从某种意义上说，婠婠只是她的分体，
但这十几年来，她们朝夕相处，婠婠早已不是简单的分体，而是一个有血有肉，有独立思想和感情的人。
她怎么可能…怎么可能亲手吞噬自己的女儿?
content_en:
In the forest boundary, Yanyu Tower.
This palace, which stood on top of the mist-shrouded green hills, was currently shrouded in an atmosphere of deathly silence.
In the main hall, more than a dozen elders from Yanyu Tower gathered together, and everyone's face was filled with anxiety and despair.
"Master, there are only two days left for the Blood Evil Sect's deadline!"
A white-haired elder said in a trembling voice. His hand was holding the crutch tightly, and his knuckles were white from excessive exertion.
"Do we really want to watch Yanyu Tower being wiped out?"
Another elder asked through gritted teeth, his eyes filled with unwillingness.
On the main seat, Qin Yuebai sat quietly.
She was wearing a long white dress, with stunning appearance and extraordinary temperament, as if she had been banished to earth.
But there was deep exhaustion and helplessness in those beautiful eyes.
"Elders, why don't I want to protect Yanyu Tower?"
She said softly, with a hint of bitterness in her voice.
"But Xue Wuya is in the 6th level of magical power. Even if I try my best, I am no match for him."
"Owner!"
A middle-aged elder suddenly stood up, a trace of madness flashing in his eyes.
"We all know that your Bingdi Lotus body has a special ability..."
He didn't finish his words, but everyone understood what he meant.
The atmosphere in the hall instantly solidified.
Qin Yuebai's body trembled slightly. She slowly raised her head and scanned everyone present.
"You...want me to swallow Huanhan?"
Her voice was very soft, but everyone could hear her clearly.
"Excuse me, owner!"
The middle-aged elder knelt down, but his tone remained firm.
"But this is the only way! Your parallel lotus bodies are twins. If you can unite the two bodies into one, you will definitely be able to break through the sixth realm! By then, what will blood be like? Our Yanyu Tower can not only save it, but also dominate the forest realm in one fell swoop!"
"Yes! Owner, for the lives of thousands of disciples in Yanyu Tower, you must make a choice!"
"Master, in the face of justice, we cannot be kind to women!"
One after another, the elders knelt down, their voices getting louder and more urgent.
Qin Yuebai closed his eyes.
She knew that what these elders said was right.
The special thing about the parallel-pedicle lotus body is that it is a twin body that can split into another individual or re-integrate into one body.
And once they become one, the superposition of the two forces will definitely allow her to break through her current realm.
But...
She opened her eyes and her eyes fell on the girl standing quietly in the corner of the hall.
Qin Huan.
Her "daughter".
Although in a sense, Huanwan is just a separate part of her,
But for more than ten years, they have been getting along day and night, and Huanhua is no longer a simple separation, but a person of flesh and blood, with independent thoughts and feelings.
How could she...how could she devour her own daughter with her own hands?
